name: better-lyrics
description: Enhance YouTube Music with beautiful time-synced lyrics, multilingual support, real-time translations and more

scripts.dev: npm run generate:locales && extension dev --browser chrome --profile dist/extension-js/profiles/chrome-profile/dev
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run generate:locales && extension dev --browser firefox
scripts.dev:brave: npm run generate:locales && extension dev --chromium-binary "/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser" --profile dist/extension-js/profiles/chromium-profile/dev
scripts.start: npm run generate:locales && extension start --browser chrome --profile dist/extension-js/profiles/chrome-profile/dev
scripts.start:brave: npm run generate:locales && extension start --chromium-binary "/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser" --profile dist/extension-js/profiles/chromium-profile/dev
scripts.build: npm run generate:locales && extension build --browser all
scripts.build:nativune: npm run generate:locales && tsc --noEmit && extension build --browser chrome
scripts.build:zip: npm run generate:locales && extension build --browser all --zip

author: boidushya
